## Contributor checklist

Please confirm each item before requesting review. See `CONTRIBUTING.md` for details.

- [ ] **Frontmatter complete**: `slug`, `language`, `title`, `description` and `date` are present and accurate
- [ ] **Both languages**: `de.md` and `en.md` exist and declare `available_languages: ["de", "en"]`
- [ ] **Language tags on fences**: every fenced code block declares a language (for example `bash`, `yaml`, `json`)
- [ ] **No em-dashes**: replaced with a comma, colon or period in user-facing text
- [ ] **Images optimized**: compressed screenshots, semantic filenames, descriptive alt text, stored in the guide's `images/` folder
- [ ] **Cross-refs use canonical paths**: internal links point at the guide's folder path under `/tutorials/`, no `../` chains and no `.md` targets
- [ ] **Spell-checked** in both languages of the page
- [ ] **Checks pass**: the automated checks on this PR are green
- [ ] **Links and languages verified**: `npm run check` ran locally, or you checked the internal links and the second language by hand
